landing.title: Book your therapy session, and keep moving between visits.
landing.lead: Choose a time at the center online and follow your sessions in one place. At home, the Android app counts each exercise against the range your therapist sets.
landing.step1Detail: Four short steps, then enter the code we email you.
landing.step2Detail: See which times are open and how many places are left. If a time is full, you can wait for a place.
landing.step3Detail: You get a notification and an email, and the session appears on My Schedule. You can move or cancel it online, within the center's rules.
landing.appDetail: Exercises run in the Android app, because they need the phone camera. It follows the joint and counts each repetition that reaches your target.
landing.appWeb: Everything else works in your browser too: bookings, your schedule, notifications, progress and your profile.
landing.appNoLink: The app is not in a store yet. Ask your center how to install it.
landing.appQr: QR code for the Android app
landing.appDial: A sample session: reached 14 to 112 degrees of a 20 to 120 degree target
landing.therapistsDetail: Invite patients, prescribe ranges and your own exercises, follow progress on a large screen, and mark who came to each session.
landing.schedulersDetail: Confirm requests, run the center's calendar and holidays, and export the schedule.
landing.administratorsDetail: Manage accounts, care-team links and the exercise catalogue. Every change is confirmed and audited.
landing.privacyTitle: Camera frames stay on the phone.
landing.privacyDetail: Only consented movement summaries are saved. No images, video or landmarks are stored.
landing.notValidated: Development prototype. Movement measurements require professional validation.
landing.demoLabel: A sample skeleton measuring elbow flexion
landing.demoHint: Take the hand and move the arm yourself.

signup.promise: Book your sessions and follow your progress from one account.
signup.accountHelp: You will use this email and password to sign in. We will send a confirmation code to this email.
signup.personalHelp: Use your name as you want it shown to your care team.
signup.contactHelp: Your therapist uses these details to reach you.
signup.reviewHelp: Check your details, then read and accept the privacy agreement to create your account.
signup.fixFields: Check the highlighted fields to continue.
signup.consentNeeded: Accept the privacy agreement to create your account.
signup.point1: Your connected therapist can see your profile details to support your care.
signup.point2: Your rehabilitation records are used only for session tracking and progress review.
signup.point3: You can edit your profile, or request a copy or deletion of your data, from Profile. Requests are reviewed first.
signup.point4: Recording movement summaries needs separate consent before your first session.
signup.usernameRefused: That account could not be created. The username may already be in use, so try another.
signup.codeDetail: Enter the code we sent to {{email}}. We create your account only after you enter it, so if the code expires, sign up again.
signup.codeNote: If this email already has an account, no code is sent. Sign in instead.
signup.codeExpired: This code is wrong or has expired. Check the newest email from Motivance. If 10 minutes have passed since it was sent, sign up again.
signup.staffNote: Staff accounts are created by an administrator.
